title: Mobile weekly reschedule tap fix
objective: Resolve the mobile weekly schedule report that a Saturday 1pm student could not be changed/tapped into the 3pm slot by making mobile week/day cells tappable after every schedule rerender, deploying Firebase and Vercel, and recording verification evidence.

diagnosis.rootCause: Several schedule mutation paths replaced #content with buildMobileSchedule()/buildSchedule() without re-running attachMobileEvents(), leaving newly-rendered mobile [data-cell] elements without click handlers. Weekly cells also had no inline fallback handler, so a mobile user could hit a dead empty slot after a reschedule/remove/bulk/update refresh.

changes.summary: Added renderScheduleContent() so schedule redraws always reattach mobile events.
Added mCellClick(el,event) and assigns cell onclick handlers idempotently from attachMobileEvents().
Added inline onclick fallback plus mobile tap affordance styles to mobile week/day empty cells.
Replaced all direct schedule #content redraw paths with renderScheduleContent().
Bumped service worker cache to vs-v2-2026-06-19-mobile-week-tap-fix.
Added invariants for mobile rerender/cell tap fallback and updated SW version gate.

localMobileRescheduleFlow.scenario: Synthetic 수강중 fixed student at 토 13:00 changed to 토 15:00 through openTempReschedule/saveTempReschedule.

remainingAggregateBlockers.blocker: Live split Firestore write/dual-read receipt still requires an authenticated admin browser session.
Live Storage upload/cross-device media verification still requires an authenticated admin browser session.
